We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to produce JSON route with 5 reactions. We have guidance: steps enumerated forward: TBS protection, HWE, DIBAL-H reduction, TMSOTf protection, Still-Gennari. But we need retrosynthetic steps (reverse). So we need to break down target into precursors via reverse of those transformations.

We need to find appropriate templates. We have one template for deprotection of TBS (template 29646) which is reverse of TBS protection: it converts protected alcohol to free alcohol. The retro template is [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]... So applying that to target will give a TBS-protected precursor.

Our target has multiple OH groups: there is a primary alcohol at side chain (CO) maybe free OH? Actually target: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O. Contains a free OH at C1 (attached to O before ring). Also an O-CH2-? Actually O[C@H]1... there is an O attached to chiral carbon (maybe a free OH). Also there is an O[C@@H]... an ether linking to side chain. Also a carboxylic acid at end (C(O)=O). So we need 5 steps.

Potential retrosynthesis:

Step1: Deprotect TBS group (if present) to give free alcohol. But target currently has free OH, not TBS. So maybe forward step was TBS protection, so retrosynthetic step is deprotection? Actually forward: protect alcohol with TBS, then later deprotect. In retrosynthesis we go backward: target (final product) likely after deprotection, so previous step is TBS-protected intermediate. So we need to add TBS group to the alcohol(s). So we need to apply reverse of deprotection: i.e., protect with TBS. That is the forward of template 29646. So we need a template that adds TBS to an alcohol. The template we have is for deprotection (retro). But we can use it in reverse direction? The tool apply_template applies retrosynthetic template (i.e., reverse direction). So using template 29646 on target will give TBS-protected precursor (since retro template removes OH and adds TBS). Indeed the retro template is [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]... So applying to target will replace OH with TBS-protected O. Good.

Thus step1: apply template 29646 to target to get precursor with TBS group on that alcohol.

Now step2: maybe Still-Gennari reaction to form (Z)-alkene from aldehyde and phosphonate. So we need to break a double bond and carboxylic acid? Actually target has a conjugated diene and a carboxylic acid at end. Still-Gennari forms double bond and carboxylic ester. Our target has carboxylic acid, not ester. So maybe earlier step had ester, then hydrolysis to acid. So step2 could be hydrolysis of ester to acid (not in list). But we have only given reactions: TBS protection, HWE, DIBAL-H, TMSOTf protection, Still-Gennari. Need 5 steps, likely these are the steps forward. So retrosynthesis steps are reverse of those: 1) deprotect TBS (reverse of protection) -> we already did. 2) reverse of Still-Gennari: break double bond to give aldehyde and phosphonate ester. 3) reverse of DIBAL-H reduction: convert aldehyde to ester? Actually DIBAL reduces ester to aldehyde; reverse would be oxidation of aldehyde to ester (or maybe formation of ester from acid). But we can treat as oxidation to ester. 4) reverse of HWE: break C-C double bond to give aldehyde and phosphonate? Wait HWE forms alkene from aldehyde + phosphonate. Reverse would be retro-HWE: break alkene to give aldehyde and phosphonate. But we already used Still-Gennari for that. Maybe we need both HWE and Still-Gennari for different double bonds.

The target has multiple double bonds: a diene chain (C/C=C/C=C/). Could be formed via HWE (E) and Still-Gennari (Z) to set geometry. So we need two steps for each double bond formation.

Thus retrosynthesis steps:

Step1: Remove TBS protecting group (apply template 29646) -> get precursor with TBS-protected alcohol.

Step2: Retro-Still-Gennari on the terminal double bond adjacent to carboxylic acid to give aldehyde and phosphonate ester (still with TBS). So need template for Still-Gennari. Not sure ID. Could search.

Search for functional groups broken: "C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters" formed: "aldehydes". Already attempted but got none. Maybe need to specify functional_groups_formed: ["aldehydes"] and broken: ["C-C double bonds","carboxylic esters"] gave none. Could be that template not in catalog. Might need to search for HWE: broken: ["C-C double bonds"], formed: ["aldehydes","carboxylic esters"]? Actually forward HWE forms double bond, breaks C-P and C-O. Reverse would break double bond to give aldehyde and phosphonate. So broken: ["C-C double bonds"], formed: ["aldehydes","carboxylic esters"]? Not sure.

Let's try search for HWE reverse: functional_groups_broken: ["C-C double bonds"], functional_groups_formed: ["aldehydes","carboxylic esters"].
